name: Pec Deck (Machine Fly)
justification: Most common commercial-gym chest isolation machine. Currently only an alias of cable-fly; give it its own slug and drop the "Pec Deck" alias from cable-fly.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
justification: Smith machine is in every commercial gym; SMITH already exists in the equipment enum but no catalog row uses it.

name: Smith Machine Incline Press
justification: Very common upper-chest press; fills the empty SMITH equipment slot.

name: Incline Machine Chest Press
justification: Machine option for the incline-press swap group (currently barbell/DB/push-up only).

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
justification: Classic bench variant; lower priority (decline bench not universal).

name: Cable Crossover (High to Low)
justification: Standing high-pulley crossover is the default cable chest move; existing cable-fly uses a flat-bench photo. Drop "Cable Crossover" alias from cable-fly.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
justification: Upper-chest cable fly variant.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
justification: Home/DB upper-chest isolation.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
justification: Home users without a bench (DUMBBELLS profile) need a horizontal press that does not assume a bench.

name: Kneeling Push-Up
justification: Beginner regression for bodyweight users (ACSM 2026 / HHS: any RT counts; beginners need an entry point). No faithful fedb id (wger #1218 "knee push-ups" has no image).

name: Standing Cable Chest Press
justification: Cable-only gyms / functional trainer.

name: Seated Machine Row
justification: Plate-loaded/selectorised seated row is a commercial-gym staple distinct from chest-supported T-bar.

name: T-Bar Row
justification: Landmine/T-bar row (standing). NOTE: "T-Bar Row" is currently an alias of chest-supported-row - move the alias.

name: Pendlay Row
justification: Popular strict barbell row; no faithful fedb id (Bent_Over_Barbell_Row is not dead-stop).

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
justification: Two-DB row for home users without a bench.

name: Close-Grip (V-Bar) Lat Pulldown
justification: Neutral/close-grip pulldown is as common as wide-grip. (Close-Grip_Front_Lat_Pulldown instructions describe a wide bar - do not use.)

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
justification: Supinated pulldown variant.

name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
justification: Unilateral pull (ACSM 2009 recommends unilateral + bilateral exercises).

name: Single-Arm Seated Cable Row
justification: Unilateral cable row.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
justification: Only DB option for the lat-isolation swap group (home users). fedb lists chest as primary; muscle emphasis is debated - lats primary chosen to fit the slot.

name: Band Pull-Apart
justification: Cheapest rear-delt/upper-back option for home users; BAND already in enum, unused.

name: Cable Rear-Delt Fly
justification: Cable variant for rear-delt group.

name: Barbell Shrug
justification: Only DB shrug exists; barbell is the default gym shrug.

name: Rack Pull
justification: Common partial deadlift for upper-back/lockout work.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
justification: vertical-press group has no machine option; very common in commercial gyms.

name: Arnold Press
justification: Staple DB press variant.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
justification: Home users without an upright bench.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
justification: Smith variant.

name: Landmine Press
justification: Shoulder-friendly press, popular in commercial gyms. No faithful fedb id (Landmine_Linear_Jammer is a different, explosive drill).

name: Push Press
justification: Power-type lift; ACSM 2026 finds power training / Olympic-style lifting enhances power. fedb entry has EMPTY instructions (photos only).

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
justification: Common isolation; needs NEW pattern+swap group "front-raise" (or reuse lateral-raise swap group).

name: Machine Lateral Raise
justification: Machine option for lateral-raise group. No fedb entry (wger #1654 has a CC-BY-SA 4.0 photo by "roneydya").

name: Band Lateral Raise
justification: Band option for home users.

name: Upright Row
justification: Common but needs NEW pattern "upright-row"; swaps sensibly into lateral-raise.

name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
justification: Rotator-cuff prehab. NEW pattern + swap group; vocabulary has no "rotator-cuff" muscle - rear-delts is the nearest term (flag).

name: Band External Rotation
justification: Home version of the above.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
justification: Most common bar curl after barbell curl.

name: Concentration Curl
justification: Staple DB isolation.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
justification: Requested; common cable variant.

name: Zottman Curl
justification: Requested; biceps + forearms.

name: Reverse-Grip Barbell Curl
justification: Forearm/brachioradialis emphasis.

name: Spider Curl
justification: Popular short-length biceps variant.

name: Machine Biceps Curl
justification: Machine option for biceps group.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
justification: Single-arm preacher variant.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
justification: Users log rope and bar separately. "Rope Pushdown" is currently an alias of triceps-pushdown - move it if added.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
justification: Staple home triceps isolation.

name: Bench Dip
justification: Most common home triceps move (needs only a chair/bench).

name: Triceps Dip (Parallel Bars)
justification: Upright-torso dip; chest-dip already covers the bar setup.

name: Assisted Dip (Machine)
justification: Commercial-gym staple for users who cannot dip bodyweight. No faithful fedb id (Dip_Machine is a seated dip press, not counter-weighted assistance).

name: Seated Dip Machine
justification: Selectorised seated dip/triceps press.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
justification: Only forearm isolation; NEW pattern "wrist-flexion" and swap group "forearm".

name: Smith Machine Squat
justification: Very common squat variant; uses existing SMITH enum.

name: Pendulum Squat
justification: Increasingly common machine; no fedb/wger photo.

name: Belt Squat
justification: Spine-friendly squat machine; no fedb photo.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
justification: Home adductor-biased squat.

name: Dumbbell Step-Up
justification: Staple unilateral leg exercise; HHS/WHO stress balance & functional strength for older adults - step-ups double as stair-climbing practice.

name: Bodyweight Step-Up
justification: Bodyweight/older-adult functional exercise. No faithful fedb id (Step-up_with_Knee_Raise is a different drill).

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
justification: Loaded reverse lunge (only bodyweight version exists).

name: Barbell Lunge
justification: Barbell lunge variant.

name: Lateral Lunge
justification: Frontal-plane leg work, adductors. No fedb strength entry.

name: Pistol Squat
justification: Advanced bodyweight progression (bodyweight squat tops out quickly). wger #456 has CC-BY-SA 4.0 photos by "wakanda90".

name: Wall Sit
justification: Isometric quad exercise for beginners/older adults; timed.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
justification: Hugely common, beginner-friendly deadlift. Model as BARBELL + alias "Hex Bar Deadlift" (a TRAP_BAR enum value would need the API-level gating used for cardio equipment).

name: Sumo Deadlift
justification: Second standard deadlift stance.

name: Good Morning
justification: Requested barbell hinge.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
justification: Floor version of the hip thrust (no bench).

name: Kettlebell Swing
justification: THE kettlebell staple. fedb only has One-Arm_Kettlebell_Swings (empty instructions) - near-miss for the two-hand swing, so null; or add single-arm-kettlebell-swing with that id.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
justification: Beginner/home hinge; no fedb id.

name: Kettlebell Single-Leg Deadlift
justification: Loaded single-leg hinge; balance (HHS older-adult multicomponent).

name: Hip Adduction Machine
justification: Mirror of the existing abductor machine; "adductors" already in MUSCLES vocab but no exercise targets it as primary. NEW pattern+swap "hip-adduction".

name: Cable Glute Kickback
justification: Requested; very common glute isolation.

name: Glute Kickback Machine
justification: Machine variant; no fedb photo.

name: Donkey Kick
justification: Bodyweight glute isolation (fedb "Glute_Kickback" is the quadruped bodyweight kickback).

name: Standing Single-Leg Curl
justification: Unilateral leg-curl machine.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
justification: GHD staple in strength gyms.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
justification: Home abductor option. fedb Monster_Walk walks forward/back - acceptable but not exact; null it if strictness matters.

name: Clamshell
justification: Bodyweight abductor option (hip-abduction group has no home exercise).

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
justification: Common when no calf machine.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
justification: The fedb Goblet_Squat id IS a kettlebell goblet squat (current goblet-squat is DUMBBELL). Alternative: keep one slug and add an alias.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Press
justification: KB press. fedb only has two-bell / to-the-side variants - near-misses, so null.

name: Kettlebell Clean
justification: KB power movement; NEW pattern "explosive-pull" / swap group "power".

name: Turkish Get-Up
justification: Requested; full-body stability. NEW pattern "get-up".

name: Power Clean
justification: ACSM 2026: Olympic-style lifting enhances power; staple for barbell athletes. NEW pattern/swap.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
justification: Straight-leg progression of hanging-knee-raise. fedb photo is a leg raise, so MOVE this id here and drop "Hanging Leg Raise" alias from hanging-knee-raise.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
justification: Vertical-knee-raise station common in gyms.

name: Crunch
justification: Most basic floor ab exercise; no bodyweight floor core-flexion exists.

name: Reverse Crunch
justification: Floor alternative to hanging raises for home users.

name: Lying Leg Raise
justification: Bench/floor leg raise.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
justification: Loadable machine core flexion.

name: Dead Bug
justification: Core anti-extension staple for beginners/rehab.

name: Bird Dog
justification: Core staple, also balance. Not in fedb; wger #1572 has a CC-BY-SA 4.0 image by "Settebello".

name: Side Plank
justification: Anti-lateral-flexion is missing from the catalog. NEW pattern "anti-lateral-flexion". fedb Side_Bridge has EMPTY instructions (photo only).

name: Hollow Body Hold
justification: Bodyweight progression beyond plank.

name: Cable Woodchop
justification: Requested; rotational core. NEW pattern "rotation".

name: Suitcase Carry
justification: Unilateral carry = anti-lateral-flexion. No fedb id (wger #1776 no image).
